mapper.sql: e.id, e.occurred_at AS occurredAt, e.seq, e.request_id AS requestId, e.parent_request_id AS parentRequestId, e.category, e.title, e.summary, e.actor, e.outcome, e.source_type AS sourceType, e.source_id AS sourceId, e.trace_id AS traceId, e.workspace_id AS workspaceId, e.data_label AS dataLabel, e.source_event_id AS sourceEventId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeline_entry (id, occurred_at, seq, request_id, parent_request_id, category, title, summary, actor, outcome, source_type, source_id, trace_id, workspace_id, data_label, source_event_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{occurredAt}, #{seq}, #{requestId}, #{parentRequestId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{actor}, #{outcome}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{traceId}, #{workspaceId}, #{dataLabel}, #{sourceEventId}) ON CONFLICT (source_event_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO timeline_entry_subject (entry_id, subject_type, subject_id, workspace_id) VALUES (#{entryId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{workspaceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM timeline_entry WHERE source_event_id = #{sourceEventId} LIMIT 1

#{eid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM timeline_entry WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND occurred_at >= #{from}::timestamptz AND occurred_at <= #{to}::timestamptz
mapper.select: SELECT source_type AS sourceType, cursor_ts AS cursorTs, cursor_id AS cursorId, last_event_id AS lastEventId, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM timeline_projection_cursor WHERE source_type = #{sourceType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeline_projection_cursor (source_type, cursor_ts, cursor_id, last_event_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{cursorTs}, #{cursorId}, #{lastEventId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (source_type) DO UPDATE SET cursor_ts = EXCLUDED.cursor_ts, cursor_id = EXCLUDED.cursor_id, last_event_id = EXCLUDED.last_event_id, updated_at = now()
